liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Candyman** (1 review): Candyman is noted as one of the best versions the listener has heard [11]
- Dark Star and The Other One are relatively short but well played [10]

## The recordings

- **gd_nrps70-05-15.sbd.reynolds-kaplan.29473.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 67 songs; 420 min; rated 4.78/5 by 45 [1]
- **gd70-05-15.early-late.sbd.97.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 63 songs; 391 min; rated 4.76/5 by 95 [2]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the board recording as fantastic from a pivotal musical moment; Sound quality is surprisingly good, with the acoustic set particularly enjoyable; The Fillmore East show is described as genuinely hot, not just famous for availability [6][11][13][14][15]
- **gd1970-05-15.136575.late.aud.cooper.berger.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: First track has mic rustling and static from previously recorded cassette [3]
- **gd1970-05-15.136574.late.aud.cooper.berger.flac24**: audience recording; 23 songs; 157 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Listener sat fifth row center, witnessing the seamless Dead and New Riders performance [8]
- Jerry and Bobby exchange amusing banter between acoustic songs during the performance [9]
- Listener compares this 1970 performance to the Harpur's Collage Dick's Pick recording [5]
- Show is less well-known than the 5/2/70 or 2/13/70 performances [10]
- Highly circulated before CDs, comparable to 2/13-14/70 and 5/2/70 Dick's Picks [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd_nrps70-05-15.sbd.reynolds-kaplan.29473.shnf**: transferred by Chuck Reynolds and Seth Kaplan.; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Analog to digital transfer created to preserve master reels as true copies [1]
- **gd70-05-15.early-late.sbd.97.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Leigh Orf, David Hollister, Jeff Tiedrich and David Finney; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1970-05-15.136575.late.aud.cooper.berger.flac16**: taped by Jim Cooper; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy Cooper; 2 hitachi mics > hitachi trq-222; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc >… [3]
- **gd1970-05-15.136574.late.aud.cooper.berger.flac24**: taped by Jim Cooper; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy Cooper; 2 hitachi mics > hitachi trq-222; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc >… [4]
